mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND currency = #{currency}

SELECT mc.model_name AS modelName, mc.display_name AS displayName, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(tu.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN model_config mc ON tu.model_config_id = mc.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY tu.model_config_id, mc.model_name, mc.display_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM token_usage WHERE usage_date >= #{startDate} AND usage_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS value FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_date >= #{startDate} AND usage_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY usage_date ORDER BY usage_date

SELECT tu.usage_type AS usageType, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(tu.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage tu WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.usage_date >= #{startDate} AND tu.usage_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY tu.usage_type ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT mc.model_name AS modelName, mc.display_name AS displayName, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(tu.total_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN model_config mc ON tu.model_config_id = mc.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.usage_date >= #{startDate} AND tu.usage_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY tu.model_config_id, mc.model_name, mc.display_name ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, agent_id, user_id, model_config_id, usage_type, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cost, currency, latency_ms, success, error_message, trace_id, usage_date, created_at FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND total_tokens > 0 AND (cost IS NULL OR cost = 0 OR currency IS NULL OR currency = '') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
